To sync rules, keep GodViewer running in the background before you edit views in a target app.
Get GodViewer working in a few steps
Root your device and install a working LSPosed (or compatible Xposed) framework. Reboot after installation.
Open LSPosed → Modules → enable GodViewer. You only need to scope the target apps you want to edit — the host app itself does not need to be in scope.
Add the apps you want to inspect to the module scope, then force-stop those apps (or reboot) so hooks load cleanly.

Open a scoped app, pull down the notification shade, and use the edit-mode entry (default: the target app\'s notification; optional: GodViewer host notification in Settings): Enable / Undo / Manage Rules. Then tap a view, adjust size / margin / padding / visibility / text / image, and Apply. Rules are saved inside the target app and replay after restart.

• Default entry is the target app notification. If the target app does not request notification permission, choose the host notification entry (Settings → Edit-mode entry).
• Host entry mode: keep GodViewer alive in the background so it can control the last foreground target.
• Synced rules on the Rules tab are read-only mirrors pushed when a target saves rules.
• Corrupt rule files are ignored safely and will not crash the target app.
If the target app does not request notification permission, choose the host notification entry
Notification permission is required for the host entry. You can grant it in system settings.
Remove the launcher shortcut. Reopen via the persistent notification, LSPosed module settings, or the system app list.

GodViewer changelog

3.3.2
• Move edit-mode entry to GodViewer host notification (enable / undo / manage rules); targets no longer need notification permission
• More stable edit intercept via Activity touch dispatch + force-clickable refresh
• Clear stale target when reopening the host app
• Isolate injected dialogs from target themes; unify palette with host UI; fix advanced editor blank content

3.2.2
• Donate page with WeChat Pay and Alipay QR codes
• Align secondary page toolbars with primary tab titles

3.2.1 — New UI version
• Host bottom navigation: Home / Guide / Rules / Settings
• Rule mirror list with app icons and detail pages
• Settings: language (system/zh/en), hide desktop icon, check updates, auto-update preference, changelog, user agreement
• Global watermark and tab fade animation

2.2.1
• Cap preview image height so edit buttons stay visible for large views

2.2.0
• Rule manager in the injected UI
• Persist and replay view rules after app restart
